cohort: The study included 21 rabbit kittens with surgically induced congenital diaphragmatic hernia and 19 control littermates, delivered by caesarean section at 30 days gestation.
finding: A small constant external negative pressure applied during mechanical ventilation improved lung aeration and achieved set tidal volumes with significantly lower peak inflation pressures in rabbit kittens with diaphragmatic hernia.
